lesson.child_mission: Recording and comparing results means using tables or graphs and noticing that samples vary even when the chance setup stays the same.
lesson.evidence_instructions: Save the independent response, specific revisions and both short-answer explanations; record oral evidence for speaking tasks.
lesson.extension: Apply the same method to a larger number or a new context, then compare two solution paths for accuracy.
lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Two students spin a fair 2-colour spinner 10 times each. One gets 7 red, one gets 4 red. What can you say?

FEEDBACK
Both results possible; small samples vary; more trials give a clearer picture.

WATCH FOR
Declaring a die “broken” after three rolls ignores natural variation.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Compare two experiment result tables (yours vs a partner or given set). Make a combined graph. Write three comparison sentences including one about variation.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

Parent: Written model 2: Common error: Declaring a die “broken” after three rolls ignores natural variation. Correction: Both results possible; small samples vary; more trials give a clearer picture.

Parent: Likely misconception: Declaring a die “broken” after three rolls ignores natural variation. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

teach_steps.explain:
Recording and comparing results means using tables or graphs and noticing that samples vary even when the chance setup stays the same.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
